about: Mochi Link v1 AES-256-GCM vectors. key, nonce and box are base64url without padding; box = ciphertext || 16-byte tag; ad and plaintext are UTF-8. Every client (Swift, TypeScript, Python, Dart) must produce box from the rest and open it again. Made with CryptoKit.
